extracted.name: Homemade Caramel Sauce
extracted.description: This homemade Caramel Sauce recipe transforms five basic pantry staples into a rich and creamy caramel sauce. Enjoy it on top of ice cream, in your hot chocolate, or literally over anything! It's so easy and only takes 10 minutes to make!
ingredient_lines: 1 1/2 cups light brown sugar (, firmly packed)
1/2 cup evaporated milk (, or heavy cream, or more, to thin the sauce)
instruction_lines: Grease the sides of a medium saucepan with oil or non-stick spray. Add butter, brown sugar, water, and salt to saucepan and cook over medium-low heat, stirring constantly, until the butter has melted.
Bring the mixture to a boil., stirring constantly. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 5-8 minutes, stirring, until golden brown and thickened (keep in mind it will continue to thicken as it cools).
Remove from heat and stir in vanilla and 1/2 cup evaporated milk. Add more evaporated milk if you'd like a thinner consistency.
Store caramel sauce in a covered container or jar in the refrigerator for 1-2 weeks. Re-warm in the microwave for a few seconds, or on the stove over low heat.
